validation.novelty_status_all_unverified: All 18 carry novelty_status: unverified. This is a HONEST CEILING, not a hedge: see knowledge_retrieval_unavailable below.

knowledge_retrieval_unavailable.condition: CRYPTO_KB_QDRANT_URL is ':memory:', an embedded index that lives and dies with the process, so the derived crypto-kb index is EMPTY and every query returns nothing for reasons unrelated to novelty.
knowledge_retrieval_unavailable.verified_by: coordinator-ecdlp-2 called mcp__crypto-kb__search_knowledge once before dispatch and received the explicit error naming the ':memory:' misconfiguration.
knowledge_retrieval_unavailable.consequence: AGENTS.md 'Knowledge retrieval policy' assumes agents CAN query the corpus before claiming novelty. They could not. All four generators were instructed NOT to call the server and NOT to read its silence as evidence of novelty, and to screen by direct reading of knowledge/ and ledger/proposals/ instead. Every record is therefore capped at novelty_status: unverified per AGENTS.md rule 9. A reviewer with working retrieval should re-screen all 18; several records name specific recalled-but-unopened sources that could reclassify them to `known` cheaply.
knowledge_retrieval_unavailable.remediation: make -C kb qdrant-up, set CRYPTO_KB_QDRANT_URL=http://localhost:6333 in kb/.env (never in the committed client config), then crypto-kb stage-repo . and crypto-kb ingest. NOT performed by this session: starting a server is a side-effectful infrastructure change the user has not authorized.

open_judgement_flagged_by_a_generator_fo: IDEA-20260901-133fd3 citations[4] (KN-TECH-006) and IDEA-20260901-863e36 citations[4] (KN-TECH-005) are provenance: internal with a verified_by disclosing that the record itself was NOT read this session and is quoted at SECOND HAND from verbatim excerpts inside the ECDLP-IDEA-436 erratum, which WAS read in full. tools/validate_ledger.py accepts this. The generator flagged it rather than quietly relying on the pass, and the orchestrating session is recording the judgement rather than silently resolving it either way: the chain is real and fully disclosed, and neither record's novelty_status depends on those citations (both are unverified). A reviewer who reads AGENTS.md rule 9 as requiring the cited record itself to be opened, rather than a verbatim quotation of it, should downgrade both to recalled -- the generator states that change is cost-free.
orchestrator_process_gap_recorded: Both repair rounds required the generator to rewrite each file WHOLE, because the idea-generator role has no Edit tool in this runtime. The generator asked the orchestrator to git-diff the result to confirm the change was quoting-only and label-only. THE ORCHESTRATOR COULD NOT: these proposals were untracked with no committed baseline to diff against. What was verified instead is weaker -- strict parse passes, claim text intact, and every required schema field still present -- so the 'quoting only' and 'label only' properties rest on the generator's attestation rather than on a diff. This is the same gap recorded as PD-D on 2026-08-31, where a red team's amendment was provably additive by byte prefix and a validator's was not. FIX, and it is structural: commit generated records BEFORE requesting any repair, so every later amendment is diffable. From this commit forward these 18 have a baseline and the gap is closed for them.
scientific_boundary: This snapshot commit archives 18 IDEA records byte-for-byte as PROPOSALS ONLY. Proposals are not hypotheses, are not approved, and are not evidence. No hypothesis (H-*), experiment (EXP-*), evidence (EV-*) or decision (DEC-*) record is created by this commit and no status of anything changes; approval is /design-experiment under Coordinator authority. Every one of the 18 reports sota_delta +0 on the time exponent against its named baseline, and IDEA-20260901-e4184f reports memory as +1/2 WORSE than Pollard rho; no record claims an attack, speedup, novelty, closure or breakthrough in any direction, and none asserts a novelty label above unverified. The generators additionally enumerated closures with stated mechanisms and, in several cases, filed predictions that their own approach LOSES -- IDEA-20260901-1ddfd4 forecasts dimensional ascent at exponent E(2) >= 0.90 against Wesolowski's 1/3. Those are recorded as the generators' claims, reviewed by nobody, and are not adopted by this archive.
self_neutrality: The receipt cannot embed its own final hash, size, commit SHA or parent SHA. Those four remain null; every other declared path is hashed from its final pre-commit bytes under content_first.
